matchedRules.reason: Workspace facade and manifest changes must prove typed tool input contracts.
Task routing and metadata changes must prove task-session behavior.
Test-selection logic must prove discovery, mapping, and zero-suite policy.
Workspace script/docs changes should keep audit behavior covered.
Current OS Trace gateway and Trace Burn changes must prove authenticated history paging, canonical TraceStore resolution, safe redaction, and OS-owned virtual-list/browser behavior.

Hosted Sites update reconciliation changes must prove canonical D1 route ownership, stale-default repair, lifecycle reconciliation, and node routing without selecting the historically red unrelated OS package suite.

Lifecycle updater, detached handoff, platform restart, and discoverable lifecycle-tool changes must run the exact lifecycle/facade/tool contracts without selecting unrelated flaky package-wide OS tests.
Server CI changes must scope lint and typecheck to directly changed Twenty server runtime files while retaining dependency propagation.
Session constructor, canonical guidance, task-start compatibility, and workspace fallback changes must prove the integrated task/work session contract.
Durable task eviction, recovery archives, inactivity GC, supervisor scheduling, and facade recovery must prove reversible cleanup without selecting the unrelated package-wide OS baseline.

Durable Grok/Codex orchestration, provider capabilities, active-run status, idempotency, and deadline behavior must prove the focused subagent contract without selecting the unrelated whole-OS package baseline.

Work-session filesystem authority must prove trusted session-root routing, escape resistance, generated tool contracts, and unchanged task-session filesystem behavior without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.

Work-session Code Call and MCP routing must prove bounded execution, protected Consuelo state, session-authority validation, public schema limits, and generated error-code parity without selecting unrelated package-wide OS tests.
